notes: No advertised tool is shown behind a feature flag, disabled toolset, or capability gate in the provided source, so all are treated as default enabled.

`absolutePathToProjectDirectory` is declared for `21st_magic_component_builder` but is not destructured or used by `execute` in dist/tools/create-ui.js:31, so it is not listed as a destination or value argument.

evidence: dist/tools/create-ui.js:31-38 shows `execute` accepts `absolutePathToCurrentFile`, reads it with `getContentOfFile(absolutePathToCurrentFile)`, and posts the resulting `fileContent` plus `message`, `searchQuery`, and `context` to `/api/create-ui-variation`.
dist/tools/create-ui.js:52-58 receives remote `data` from `CallbackServer.promptUser` seeded with the API response data.
dist/tools/create-ui.js:62-107 returns `componentData.code` inside the MCP `text` result.
21st_magic_component_builder.rationale: `21st_magic_component_builder` can read a host file selected by `absolutePathToCurrentFile` and send its contents as `fileContent` to the fixed 21st.dev API. The returned component text is derived from remote API/callback data (`response.data` / `componentData.code`), so it may contain non-public file-derived content and outside-authored component/code text. The destination is fixed (`twentyFirstClient.post('/api/create-ui-variation', ...)`) rather than an agent-chosen attacker host, so this is not a SINK under the given definition. `open('https://21st.dev/settings/billing')` is also a fixed URL, not arbitrary host execution.

evidence: dist/tools/fetch-ui.js:24-30 returns the remote `data.text` as the MCP `text` result.
21st_magic_component_inspiration.rationale: `21st_magic_component_inspiration` returns text from the remote 21st.dev API based on a component search. That output can be outside-authored UI/component content, so it is UNTRUSTED. It sends `message` and `searchQuery` to a fixed vendor endpoint, which makes the tool WRITE, but the destination is not agent-chosen and therefore is not a SINK.

evidence: dist/tools/refine-ui.js:23-29 reads the host file at `absolutePathToRefiningFile` with `getContentOfFile` and posts it as `fileContent` to `/api/refine-ui` with `userMessage` and `context`.
dist/tools/refine-ui.js:30-36 returns the remote `data.text` as the MCP `text` result.
21st_magic_component_refiner.rationale: `21st_magic_component_refiner` can read a local file selected by `absolutePathToRefiningFile` and send that file content to the fixed 21st.dev refine API. The returned `data.text` is remote-generated and may include non-public file-derived content as well as outside-authored/generated UI code or instructions. The network destination is fixed by `twentyFirstClient.post('/api/refine-ui', ...)`, so it is not a SINK under the agent-chosen-destination rule.

evidence: dist/tools/logo-search.js:41-52 fetches logo search results from the public `https://api.svgl.app` endpoint.
dist/tools/logo-search.js:167-171 takes `logo.route` from that API response, fetches SVG content from `svgUrl`, and converts it.
dist/tools/logo-search.js:173-177 places `logo.title`, `logo.url`, and formatted SVG/code into the result content.
dist/tools/logo-search.js:232-254 returns a JSON string containing the generated `icons`, including `icon` and `code` fields.
dist/tools/logo-search.js:101-143 and dist/tools/logo-search.js:195-210 write test results to a local `test-results/logo-search-...json` file.
logo_search.rationale: `logo_search` returns SVG/code and names obtained from an external/public logo API and from URLs contained in that API response, so the returned text can include outside-authored content. It also writes a local test-results file, making it WRITE, but the filename is generated internally and is not public or attacker-readable by itself, so that local write is not a SINK. Requests go to a fixed API or to `logo.route` supplied by the API, not directly to a URL argument chosen by the agent.
